newsitem.title: USA: NEBRASKA FED CATTLE THIN AT $105/DRESSED - PRIVATE.
newsitem.headline: NEBRASKA FED CATTLE THIN AT $105/DRESSED - PRIVATE.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle trade was light near midday on Wednesday at $105.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, down $1.00 from the bulk of Tuesday's moderate sales, market sources said.
Sources said up to 2,000 head had sold by midday Wednesday, but some bids at $105.00 were passed by owners pricing cattle at $106.00.
Bids on a live basis were at $65.00 and passed by owners asking $66.00, the sources said.
"A bid at either one of those numbers (asking levels) would do a goodly business," a market source said.
